### Constants / Configuration

- `IAP_TO_SMS_STATE_SUCCESS` — Maps IAP status to SMS state: processing→process, success→pending, sent→pending, delivered→sent (`models/sms_sms.py:22`)
- `IAP_TO_SMS_FAILURE_TYPE` — Maps IAP error codes to SMS failure_type: insufficient_credit→sms_credit, wrong_number_format→sms_number_format, etc. (`models/sms_sms.py:29`)
- `BOUNCE_DELIVERY_ERRORS` — Set of failure types that are permanent bounces: {sms_invalid_destination, sms_not_allowed, sms_rejected} (`models/sms_sms.py:37`)
- `DELIVERY_ERRORS` — All delivery failure types (union of bounce + timeout/not_delivered/expired) (`models/sms_sms.py:38`)
- `ERROR_MESSAGES` — User-friendly error messages for account setup, validation, and delivery (`tools/sms_api.py:9-31`)
- `SmsApi.DEFAULT_ENDPOINT = 'https://sms.api.odoo.com'` — IAP endpoint URL (`tools/sms_api.py:57`)
- `SmsApi.PROVIDER_TO_SMS_FAILURE_TYPE` — Error code mapping (extends SmsApiBase) (`tools/sms_api.py:58-62`)
- `mail_notification & mail_thread mixins` — Extended models for SMS fallback in notification workflows (`models/mail_*.py`)

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Belongs with Notifications component** — Extends mail.message, mail.notification for SMS as alternative delivery channel; shares template pattern with mail.template
- **Boundary code** — HTTP webhook (/sms/status) receives delivery reports from external IAP service; updates internal state machine
- **Provider abstraction** — SmsApiBase allows pluggable SMS providers (IAP primary, custom/Twilio via inheritance)
- **IAP-coupled** — Current implementation tightly depends on Odoo In-App Purchase API; account credentials stored in iap.account model
- **State machine** — SMS states (outgoing, process, pending, sent, error, canceled) drive retries and cleanup; delivery_errors trigger failed status
- **UUID tracking** — Each SMS gets a unique uuid for correlation with delivery reports from provider (delivery webhook uses uuid lookup)
- **Configuration-driven** — Batch size, IAP endpoint, sender name, opt-out logic all configurable via ir.config_parameter / ir.model field attributes
- **Multi-provider ready** — _split_by_api() allows per-company SMS provider selection (prepares for future Twilio/custom integrations)
